messages:
nina: FYI I'm opening a small RFC to tighten partner SIEM handbacks: default retention 10 days, mandatory RBAC gating, and a KMS-unlock proxy. Want input on the approval flow and legal hold behavior. @omar @infra-chris
omar: 10d is conservative but ok for partner handbacks if extension is easy. Key asks: who can request, who can approve, and who can actually run the export.
infra-chris: RBAC proposal: three scoped permissions - `logs:export:request`, `logs:export:approve`, `logs:export:execute`. Only `execute` role allowed to call the KMS-proxy. We'll restrict `execute` to a small allowlist of machine accounts and require short-lived tokens.
legal-elia: Legal: default 10d is acceptable for routine partner scopes. MUST have a documented legal_hold override that preserves data until explicit release and records approver IDs and timestamp. Under legal_hold, automatic unwraps should be blocked.
nina: KMS-unlock design: approver flips `approved=true` on the request record. Then `logs:export:execute` service calls KMS-proxy with request_id. Proxy checks approval, then calls KMS:Decrypt with EncryptionContext.request_id and returns ephemeral unwrap token to runner (TTL 6m). All activity logged to CloudTrail and we emit a SIEM event `export.unseal` with request_id, approver, executor.
omar: CMK policy notes: require `kms:encryptionContext:request_id` and a condition ensuring encryptionContext.approved == "true". Deny Decrypt if request.legal_hold == "true". Also require kms:RequestId be correlated in logs.
infra-chris: Quarantine/DLP: if `contains_sensitive` flagged, pipeline runs DLP before any external upload. Quarantined bucket path until DLP passed and approver re-approves. Lifecycle rules: non-sensitive -> delete after retention_days; sensitive -> manual GC by security once approved.
legal-elia: For legal_hold releases, require two human approvers (legal + security) and add immutable audit entries. No automatic extensions allowed under legal_hold.
nina: Minimal request schema draft:
- request_id: auto
- requester: name/email
- scope: index patterns + time range
- justification: free text
- retention_days: default 10 (max 365 or legal_hold)
- contains_sensitive: checkbox
- legal_hold: boolean
- approver: id
- executor: machine account id
- audit_links: ticket/slack
omar: Add `data_class` enum (PII, Auth, Payment, Other) so UI can auto-set DLP rules. Also add `retention_reason` free text when >10 days.
infra-chris: CLI stub for triage:
```bash
# create request
redwood logs export request --scope "auth-*:2026-03-12..2026-03-13" \
  --retention 10 --justification "partner debugging" --requester nina@redwood.ai
# approve (security)
redwood logs export approve --id REQ-2026-1133 --approver omar@redwood.ai
# execute (runner service uses service token)
redwood logs export run --id REQ-2026-1133 --runner svc-logs-exec-1
```
legal-elia: Also require the request form to surface a required `legal_contact` when `contains_sensitive` is true.

nina: Action items: 1) infra-chris - draft CMK policy + KMS-proxy sketch 2) omar - PR for RBAC role additions and allowlist 3) legal-elia - legal_hold release checklist 4) nina - finalize UI/CLI request fields. We'll review in sec sync tomorrow 11:00. :thumbsup:
